entry.name: NVIDIA-Certified Associate: Generative AI LLMs
entry.note: The entry credential in the NVIDIA program for generative AI and large language models
entry.audience: Developers and practitioners working with large language models

reading.format: Online, remotely proctored exam with multiple-choice questions; the page lists a 60-minute time limit and 50 questions (or 50-60 multiple-choice).
reading.summary: The NVIDIA-Certified Associate: Generative AI LLMs is an entry-level certification that validates foundational knowledge for developing, integrating, and maintaining AI-driven applications using generative AI and large language models with NVIDIA solutions. Passing the exam demonstrates understanding of core concepts in this area.
reading.audience: The page describes it as an entry-level credential for individuals with a basic understanding of generative AI and large language models.
reading.validity: Valid for two years from issuance; recertification by retaking the exam.
reading.prerequisites: Basic understanding of generative AI and large language models.
